articles.title: PAK vs ENG: Why Pakistan are wearing pink jerseys against England in ODI Tri-series
articles.summary: Pakistan will wear pink jerseys against England in Sunday’s ODI Tri-series match in Lahore to raise breast cancer awareness. The PCB has partnered with Pink Ribbon Breast Cancer Trust Hospital, offering free screenings and supporting treatment for patients in need. England players will wear pink ribbons. Meanwhile, Pakistan aim to secure a final spot, while England seek their first win.
